name: bandit.r008_natural_safe_watch_validation_mcw
description: Independent focused R-008 local-return bootstrap from the production-generated safe-watch footing.  The fixture's invisible observer prevents hostile interference while one registry-owned worker uses only frame-bound semantic waits from abstract structural dispatch through the first persisted production local contact; no ecology, lead, actor, geography, lifecycle, or save state is injected.

proof_gates.label: Natural structural scout commits its local ownership handoff
Natural structural scout reaches persisted local contact with its eligibility receipt

adaptive_prefix.label: advance_first_semantic_scheduler_window
adaptive_prefix.objective: Observe the current native frame and choose only its advertised six-hour wait actions.  Advance the first ordinary scheduler window from the production-generated safe-watch footing.  Do not move the player, create a camp or lead, or inject ecology state.

adaptive_prefix.label: advance_second_semantic_scheduler_window
adaptive_prefix.objective: Continue the same native worker session through the second ordinary six-hour scheduler window.  Preserve the production-owned world and treat only advertised interruptions as the next observation.

adaptive_prefix.label: advance_force_due_scheduler_window_first_hour
adaptive_prefix.objective: Continue the same native worker session through the first advertised one-hour wait toward the site-specific force-due scheduler boundary.  Do not create or alter any lifecycle state.

adaptive_prefix.label: advance_force_due_scheduler_window_second_hour
adaptive_prefix.objective: Continue the same native worker session through the second advertised one-hour wait toward the site-specific force-due scheduler boundary.  Do not create or alter any lifecycle state.

steps.label: post_load_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the worker is in the ordinary gameplay HUD before the production scheduler advances
steps.abort_reason: the independently installed safe-watch fixture did not reach ordinary gameplay

steps.label: audit_installed_safe_watch_position
steps.abort_reason: the fixture declared a safe watch OMT but did not install the avatar at that production-owned position

steps.label: audit_installed_safe_watch_turn_baseline
steps.abort_reason: the installed fixture had no readable player turn from which a later native save could be proven fresh

steps.label: advance_first_semantic_scheduler_window
steps.objective: Observe the current native frame and choose only its advertised six-hour wait actions.  Advance the first ordinary scheduler window from the production-generated safe-watch footing.  Do not move the player, create a camp or lead, or inject ecology state.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same worker accepts native semantic receipts and advances ordinary game time into the production scheduler

steps.label: advance_second_semantic_scheduler_window
steps.objective: Continue the same native worker session through the second ordinary six-hour scheduler window.  Preserve the production-owned world and treat only advertised interruptions as the next observation.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same worker reaches the site-specific force-due window without injecting ecology state

steps.label: advance_force_due_scheduler_window_first_hour
steps.objective: Continue the same native worker session through the first advertised one-hour wait toward the site-specific force-due scheduler boundary.  Do not create or alter any lifecycle state.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native scheduler advances one production-owned hour toward the deterministic force-due boundary

steps.label: advance_force_due_scheduler_window_second_hour
steps.objective: Continue the same native worker session through the second advertised one-hour wait toward the site-specific force-due scheduler boundary.  Do not create or alter any lifecycle state.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native scheduler advances a second production-owned hour toward the deterministic force-due boundary

steps.label: resolve_force_due_dispatch_at_minute_boundary
steps.expected_visible_fact: the ordinary gameplay frame remains responsive while the scheduler resolves the due production dispatch; the immediately following transition gate owns dispatch proof

steps.label: worker_owned_local_contact_and_cohesion
steps.objective: Continue this same registry-owned native session from abstract dispatch until the exact structural scout pair has transferred to local ownership and completed authoritative cohesion.  Observe after every transaction, choose further advertised semantic waits only while production evidence is advancing, then explicitly finish so the scenario can perform its terminal native save.
proof_targets: the run-bound structural pair transfers from abstract to local ownership
the same actors and generation retain one owner and complete local cohesion
the schema-11 local-return eligibility receipt is available for terminal persistence
authority: activity.ignore only when a current native interruption advertises it
invariants: do not alter ecology, actors, ownership, fixture, scenario, or binding
derive every continuation bound from the production scheduler, path progress, game mechanic, or measured rate
finish on target proof, no progress, unsafe divergence, binding change, missing receipt, or derived-bound exhaustion
steps.expected_visible_fact: the worker, rather than a fixed observation window, owns continuation through local contact and cohesion

steps.label: open_native_full_save_after_local_contact
steps.expected_visible_fact: the native Save-and-Quit confirmation is visible before the terminal production save is confirmed
steps.abort_reason: the local-contact route could not reach the native Save-and-Quit confirmation

steps.label: open_native_main_menu_quit_confirmation_after_local_contact_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved game has returned to the native main menu and exposes its authoritative quit confirmation
steps.abort_reason: the completed native save did not return to an authoritative main-menu quit confirmation

steps.label: confirm_native_process_exit_after_local_contact_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the saved native process exits before the same world is reloaded

steps.label: audit_saved_turn_after_local_contact_save
steps.abort_reason: the post-contact saved player turn did not advance from the installed fixture, so persisted ecology state would be stale or unproved

steps.label: audit_persisted_local_contact_eligibility
steps.abort_reason: the fresh production handoff did not persist the exact structural local pair, sole local owner, odd epoch, and pre-cohesion eligibility receipt

steps.label: post_local_contact_save_reload_hud
steps.expected_visible_fact: the same native save reloads into an ordinary gameplay HUD before the final feature-phase guard
steps.abort_reason: the terminal native local-contact save did not reload into ordinary gameplay according to the run-bound semantic HUD verdict

evidence_contract.claim: one fresh production route naturally dispatches a structural scout and continues in the same worker session until the first persisted local-contact handoff
evidence_contract.failure_rule: the first missing or rejected native dispatch, local handoff, or eligibility receipt is the product divergence.  Preserve its run-bound semantic receipts, transition stream, and cleanup; do not create, repair, resume, roll back, splice, or reinterpret later lifecycle state.
